title: Not Enough Buttons
description: Adds a customizable button grid to the chat screen for sending repetitive commands and messages with a single click
body:
# Not Enough Buttons
Tired of typing the same commands over and over while playing on a server? Meet Not Enough Buttons! This lightweight client-side mod divides the chat screen into an ergonomic grid, allowing you to create custom buttons to instantly send messages to the server.

Typing repetitive commands is exhausting, especially when every second counts. This mod completely eliminates that routine. Set up your panel just once to send the required text with a single mouse click during gameplay.

The intuitive edit mode activates directly within the interface using a single button. You can change button names and bound actions in just a couple of clicks.

All configurations are automatically saved into a JSON file. They are guaranteed to persist after a restart and will be available in any gaming session.

Furthermore, the modification integrates seamlessly into the game, featuring minimal dependencies and no conflicts with other mods.
